Reimbursements can be initiated for an issue that you notified us about or one that we identified at a fulfillment center. You can find details on your reimbursement or reversal transaction in the Reimbursements report ( https://sellercentral.amazon.com/reportcentral/REIMBURSEMENTS/0 ) in Seller Central:
- In the Event Date drop-down menu, select a date range and click Generate report . You can use the date in the subject line of this email as a point of reference.

- For more information, click the case ID in the Case ID column.
Thank you.

 Hoe activeer ik mijn productvermeldingen opnieuw?
 Als je de vereiste nalevingsgegevens wilt verstrekken, ga je naar de pagina Accountstatus en zoek je de aanvragen voor productconformiteit:
-
 Als je over de vereiste documentatie beschikt, volg je de instructies om je nalevingsdocumenten in te dienen. We zullen alleen producten herstellen die voldoen aan de nalevingsvereisten.
-
 Als je van mening bent dat je producten zijn vrijgesteld van deze vereisten, dien dan documentatie in waaruit blijkt wat de reden is dat ze niet aan deze nalevingsvereisten zijn onderworpen.
 Raadpleeg voor stapsgewijze instructies onze hulp-pagina Documenten voor naleving indienen of in beroep gaan tegen een documentatieverzoek .
 Om verdere impact op je account te voorkomen, sluit of verwijder je alle niet-conforme productvermeldingen die je niet van plan bent te verkopen of waartegen je niet in beroep denkt te gaan.
 Wat gebeurt er als ik deze acties niet onderneem?
 Als je de vereiste nalevingsinformatie niet verstrekt, blijven de betrokken ASIN-codes gedeactiveerd totdat jij of een andere verkooppartner die het product vermeldt de documenten verstrekt om aan de nalevingsaanvragen te voldoen.
 Wat gebeurt er met mijn FBA-voorraad voor deze producten?
 Je moet deze producten binnen 30 dagen na deze kennisgeving uit onze fulfillment centers verwijderen. Indien deze niet worden verwijderd, zullen wij de voorraad op jouw kosten verwijderen zoals beschreven in onze Amazon Services Business Solutions-overeenkomst. Meer informatie over het verwijderen van voorraad vind je op de hulp-pagina Voorraad verwijderen .

 Jak mogę ponownie aktywować oferty?
 Aby dostarczyć niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgodności z wymogami, przejdź do panelu Kondycja konta i znajdź żądania dotyczące zgodności produktu z wymogami:
-
 Jeśli dysponujesz wymaganymi dokumentami zgodności, postępuj zgodnie z instrukcjami, aby je przesłać. Przywrócimy jedynie produkty, które spełniają oczekiwania dotyczące zgodności z wymogami.
-
 Jeśli uważasz, że Twoje produkty są zwolnione z wymogów dotyczących zgodności, prześlij dokumentację wskazującą przyczynę, dla której nie podlegają one tym wymogom.
 Szczegółowe instrukcje znajdziesz na stronie Przesyłanie dokumentów dotyczących zgodności lub składanie odwołania .
 Aby uniknąć dalszych negatywnych konsekwencji wobec konta, zamknij lub usuń wszelkie niezgodne z wymogami oferty, w przypadku których nie zamierzasz kontynuować sprzedaży ani składać odwołania.
 Co się stanie, jeśli nie podejmę tych działań?
 W przypadku niedostarczenia obowiązkowych informacji dotyczących zgodności z wymogami produkty, których dotyczy problem, pozostaną nieaktywne, dopóki żądania dotyczące zgodności z wymogami nie zostaną spełnione przez Ciebie lub innego partnera sprzedaży wystawiającego dany produkt.
 Co się stanie z zapasami FBA tych produktów?
 Musisz wycofać zapasy tych produktów z centrów logistycznych w ciągu 30 dni od tego powiadomienia. Jeśli ich nie wycofasz, usuniemy je na Twój koszt zgodnie z postanowieniami Umowy Amazon Services Business Solutions. Informacje na temat sposobu wycofywania zapasów znajdziesz na stronie Wycofywanie zapasów .

 Dowiedz się więcej, oglądając film Wprowadzenie do bezpieczeństwa i zgodności produktów z wymogami w Seller University.
 W razie dodatkowych pytań prześlij zgłoszenie w panelu Kondycja konta .

 Get the most out of Customer Service by Amazon
 Use the CSBA Insights dashboard in Seller Central to:
- Review customer service contacts handled by Amazon
- Find ways to improve customer experience
- Reduce contact and return rates
 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service. Plus, maintaining less than a 95% VTR is part of the eligibility criteria for free CSBA coverage.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .
 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 How are CSBA fees calculated and applied?
 Fees are applied automatically to every shipped unit that is fulfilled by the merchant throughout Q2-2026. To learn more about program fees, go to
 Customer Service by Amazon fees .
- CSBA fees are not applied to any FBA, Easy Ship, or seller-fulfilled Prime units
- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf
- In rare instances, the contact count used for fee calculations may be lower than the total count shown on your dashboard. The difference in contacts counts does not impact your fees.
 For additional guidance, go to the

Pour accéder à votre facture REP Nous Payons en votre nom , ouvrez la pièce jointe de cet e-mail ou accédez à la section Factures des frais du vendeur et recherchez « REP Nous payons en votre nom » dans la colonne « Type de facture ».

 Pourquoi ai-je été débité ?
Les producteurs doivent payer des frais d’éco-contribution aux organismes de responsabilité des producteurs (PRO) pour les ventes de produits soumis à des obligations REP sur Amazon.fr. Comme indiqué précédemment, vous avez été automatiquement inscrit au service REP Nous payons en votre nom d’Amazon, et Amazon a payé des frais d’éco-contribution pour vos ventes, car vous répondiez à tous les critères suivants :
- Vous êtes considéré comme producteur au sens du Code de l’environnement français.
- Vous avez vendu des produits soumis à des obligations REP en France sur Amazon.fr dans les catégories en vigueur.
- Vous n’avez pas soumis de numéro d’identification unique (UIN) valide pour les catégories REP en vigueur sur le portail de conformité REP avant le dernier jour du cycle de déclaration.
Pour consulter l’état de votre inscription au service REP Nous payons en votre nom et en savoir plus sur les avantages, les frais et le fonctionnement de ce service, rendez-vous sur REP Nous payons en votre nom
Si vous estimez que les frais REP Nous payons en votre nom ont été calculés de manière incorrecte, vous pouvez introduire un recours en contactant le Support partenaire de vente. Nous examinerons votre recours et prendrons les mesures nécessaires pour rembourser le montant applicable, s’il est approuvé.

 Buongiorno,

Amazon Services
 96
 Updates to Supply Chain by Amazon, shipment of dangerous goods, Global Warehousing, Seller Assistant, and more.
 Our Seller Newsletter provides the most important policy, tool, and program updates from the past month. Stay informed about selling on Amazon.
 Supply Chain by Amazon is evolving into Amazon Supply Chain Services
 We're extending our full portfolio of freight, distribution, fulfillment, and parcel shipping solutions to businesses of all types and sizes, including those that operate beyond our store. Read more .
 You can ship dangerous goods with our Partnered Carrier program
 As of April 30, 2026, dangerous goods, or hazmat, can be shipped domestically in the US through our Partner Carrier program. Previously, the Partner Carrier program only allowed certain lithium battery products to be shipped. Now the program is expanding to all FBA-eligible dangerous goods. Read more .
 Global Warehousing & Distribution is now available in Shenzhen, China
 You can now store your inventory in bulk at a lower cost in our new Global Warehousing & Distribution (GWD) facility in Shenzhen, China, and seamlessly replenish to our US fulfillment network when needed. Read more .
 Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfilment Shopify app is live in Europe, Japan, and Canada
 Our Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) Shopify app is now also available to sellers in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Japan, and Canada to fulfil your Shopify orders using your existing Amazon inventory. By using a single pool of Amazon inventory across all your sales channels, you can simplify operations without investing in additional fulfillment infrastructure. Read more .
 Get trademark support for your brand with IP Accelerator
 Establishing your intellectual property (IP) can help you set up and run your storefront more quickly. If you're looking to secure your trademark and enroll in Brand Registry faster, our IP Accelerator program can help. The program connects you with a network of vetted legal service providers that offer trademark support. Read more .
 Understand VAT registration when expanding to EU stores
 If you want to sell in our EU stores, you need to understand your VAT (Value-Added Tax) obligation. VAT is a consumption tax applied to most goods and services sold within the EU. If you sell products in any European country, you will likely need to register for VAT in each country where you sell. Read more .
 Check review sharing eligibility with Seller Assistant
 On January 7, 2026, we announced that reviews will only be shared between product variations with minor differences that don’t affect functionality, such as color, pattern, or pack quantity. To provide you with more clarity on how this policy update applies to your products, now you can ask Seller Assistant which of your product variations are eligible for review sharing. Read more .
 Upload your seller certifications to reach B2B buyers

Amazon Services
 96
 Find out about the latest updates to VAT Calculation and more.
 Our Seller Newsletter provides the most important policy, tool and programme updates from the past month.
 VAT Calculation Services will calculate VAT by shipment as of June 1
 Effective from June 1, 2026, we’re updating Value Added Tax (VAT) Calculation Services (VCS) to comply with European e-invoicing mandates. Read more .
 Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfilment Shopify app is live in Europe, Japan and Canada
 Our Multi-Channel Fulfilment (MCF) Shopify app is now also available to sellers in Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Japan and Canada to fulfil your Shopify orders using your existing Amazon inventory. By using a single pool of Amazon inventory across all your sales channels, you can simplify operations without investing in additional fulfilment infrastructure. Read more .
 Check review sharing eligibility with Seller Assistant
 On January 7, 2026, we announced that reviews will only be shared between product variations with minor differences that don’t affect functionality, such as colour, pattern or pack quantity. To provide you with more clarity on how this policy update applies to your products, now you can ask Seller Assistant which of your product variations are eligible for review sharing. Read more .
 Get trademark support for your brand with IP Accelerator
 Establishing your intellectual property (IP) can help you set up and run your storefront more quickly. If you're looking to secure your trademark and enrol in Brand Registry faster, our IP Accelerator programme can help. The programme connects you with a network of vetted legal service providers that offer trademark support. Read more .
 Amazon recommended packing method incentive report is restored
 We’ve resolved an issue with the incentive report for the Amazon recommended packing method, and the report is now fully accessible again. Read more .
 Earn up to €240 per shipment with C2S2 PCP pallets
 From now until June 30, 2026, you can earn transportation fee reimbursements on every qualifying shipment that you make using our Customs Clearance and Shipping Services (C2S2) Partner Carrier Programme (PCP) pallet solution for your UK-to-EU cross-border shipments. Read more .
 Updated buyer satisfaction survey gives you better insights
 For self-ship sellers who provide their own customer service, we’re updating how we collect survey feedback for your buyer dissatisfaction rate metric under Customer service quality insights. We’ll use a 1-to-5 satisfaction scale instead of a Yes/No question, which lets buyers give more precise feedback on your customer service. Read more .
 Understand VAT registration when expanding to EU stores
 If you want to sell in our EU stores, you need to understand your VAT (Value-Added Tax) obligation. VAT is a consumption tax applied to most goods and services sold within the EU. If you sell products in any European country, you will likely need to register for VAT in each country where you sell. Read more .

Amazon Services
 96
 You’ll be charged for EPR eco-contribution fees paid for your sales on Amazon.co.uk in 2024 and EPR Pay on Behalf service fees
 Hello,
In 01-04-2026, you’ll be charged eco-contribution fees for your sales of products subject to Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations on Amazon.co.uk in 2024, along with EPR Pay on Behalf service fees, for the following category:
 - Packaging
 How much will I be charged?
 For 2024 sales, you’ll be charged the following:
 The eco-contribution fees that we paid for your sales of products subject to EPR obligations on Amazon.co.uk during the applicable reporting period.
 EPR Pay on Behalf service fees of £20 for each applicable EPR category.
 You can review the charges in eco-contributions report on the EPR Pay on Behalf dashboard , which will be available after the charges are processed.
 Why will I be charged?
 Effective January 1, 2025, EPR requirements apply to packaging sold in the UK, under the Packaging (EPR) Regulations 2024. Additionally, effective August 12, 2025, EPR requirements also apply to Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) sold in the UK, under an amendment to the WEEE Regulations 2013.
 If you sell packaging or WEEE on Amazon.co.uk and aren’t established in the UK, we pay eco-contribution fees for your sales, in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in the EPR Pay on Behalf service policy for third-party sellers in the UK and then debit those amounts from your selling account along with a service fee.
 When will I receive an invoice?
 You’ll receive an invoice via email between the fifth and tenth day of the month following the charge date.
 For example, if you’re charged on April 20, 2026, you’ll receive an invoice between May 5 and 10, 2026.
 Any excess amount reserved from your account for the EPR Pay on Behalf service will be released after processing the charges for the respective reporting period.
To submit an appeal within appeal window specified on EPR Pay on Behalf fees, account level reserves and refunds , take the following steps:
 Review your charges in Seller Fee invoices (filter by "EPR Pay on Behalf") or in your Eco-contributions report on EPR Pay on Behalf dashboard .
 Contact Selling Partner Support with details of the identified error.
 Provide invoice number, EPR category, ASIN, reporting period, reserve amount (if applicable), details of the issue, and error type.
 To view your EPR Pay on Behalf enrolment status, program benefits, and instructions, go to EPR Pay on Behalf .
 For more information on EPR requirements, go to Extended Producer Responsibility requirements: United Kingdom .

Amazon Services
 96
 Update VAT registration information to reinstate Inventory and FBA functionality of your Amazon.it store
 Hello,
 Your Amazon.it selling account is undergoing temporary inventory and FBA restrictions in Italy because we require you to provide a valid VAT registration number in Italy.
 Continue shipping orders and responding to customers to avoid further impact to your account. Review the details and next steps below.
 Why is this happening?
 We are taking this action because you have not provided or updated your VAT registration information in Seller Central or with respective Tax Authorities as required by Amazon's European VAT registration requirements. You must provide valid VAT registration numbers for all countries where you have VAT registration obligations, including countries where you store inventory through FBA. Your VAT registration number will only be considered valid when your legal name and address in Seller Central matches the information registered in Tax Authorities databases, and it must be activated for intra-EU transactions (VIES VAT number).
 To learn more visit our
 European VAT registration requirements help page.
 How do I restore inventory and FBA functionality?
To restore the inventory and FBA functionality of your account in Italy, you must resolve the violations mentioned above by following these steps:
 Sign in to Seller Central and click on top-right button Settings > Tax Settings >
 Add VAT numbers
 Review your VAT registration numbers for all applicable countries
 Verify your legal name and address match the information registered with tax authorities
 Update any mismatched information in Seller Central
 Ensure your VAT number is activated for intra-EU transactions (valid VIES VAT number)
 What if this was sent in error?
 If you believe your VAT information is correct and this decision was made in error, you can send an appeal.
 Provide documentation from your respective tax authority proving you have requested a valid EU VAT registration certificate or that you are in the process of getting your VAT registration number by providing VAT registration application form.
 What happens if I don't take action?
 If you don't resolve these violations, your temporary inventory and FBA restrictions will remain in place. Your account will continue to be restricted from receiving new inventory shipments and creating new FBA listings in Italy.

 Dimensions are considered certified when measured using devices that comply with the EU Measuring Instruments Directive, for example, a tape measure.

- Provide updated certified dimensions your items individually or in bulk via FBA Inventory
